note: *a iniquidade do meu calcanhar*: the blind reader heard the heel as his own sins, against *why fear*. The Latin's crux, kept open on purpose (D43); *dos meus perseguidores* is an option.
*a sua propiciação* was unknown to the blind reader (D43, HANDOFF 22). The plain clause *o que o aplaque* is the option.
*desde a glória deles*: the two Latinist runs contradicted each other, the first asking *desde*, the gate *longe da*. *desde* holds both readings; your ear decides (D43, HANDOFF 22).
*nada levará*, held against a Latinist major and a gate minor asking *não levará tudo*, which Portuguese hears as "not all of it". DRB and MS1932 both say nothing. The stylist's best line.
